metaDescription: Cabinet painting in Fulshear, TX for Cross Creek Ranch, Fulbrook & Jordan Ranch. Sprayed, factory-smooth kitchen cabinets. Free estimate today.
bodyHtml:
Fulshear's newer homes — Cross Creek Ranch, Fulbrook on Fulshear Creek, Jordan Ranch — were built with kitchens as the centerpiece, and even a five-to-ten-year-old builder cabinet finish starts to look tired against an otherwise modern home. Painting the cabinets refreshes the whole kitchen for a fraction of replacement, and it is steady work for The Proud Paintbrush across 77441.

We spray a hard, factory-smooth cabinet enamel over genuine prep — degrease, sand, and bonding primer — so the finish lasts.

Why Fulshear Cabinets Paint So Well

Because Fulshear's housing is newer, most cabinet boxes are in excellent shape and simply carry a builder-standard stain or finish. That is the perfect cabinet to paint: nothing structural to fix, so a crisp sprayed color makes the kitchen look custom. Two-tone islands and warm whites are especially popular in Cross Creek Ranch kitchens.

Our Cabinet Painting Process

  • Label & remove — every door and drawer front tracked for exact reinstallation.
  • Degrease & sand — grease cut, surfaces scuffed, so the coating bonds.
  • Bonding primer — adheres to slick builder finishes and prevents chipping.
  • Spray & cure — sprayed enamel, cured between coats, reinstalled and aligned.

Why Fulshear Homeowners Choose Us

We are a local Fort Bend crew, not a franchise; the estimator runs your job, and every project carries our written workmanship warranty. See the full cabinet painting process, pair it with a kitchen repaint, view cabinet pricing, or request a free estimate.

faqs.q: Do you paint cabinets in Cross Creek Ranch?
faqs.a: Yes — Cross Creek Ranch is our primary Fulshear area for cabinet and kitchen painting, including upgrading builder-grade cabinet finishes.

faqs.q: My home is newer — is cabinet painting worth it?
faqs.a: Yes. Builder cabinet finishes are applied fast and look generic; a proper sprayed repaint makes a newer kitchen look custom for far less than replacement.

faqs.q: What finish do you use on cabinets?
faqs.a: A sprayed, cabinet-grade enamel over a bonding primer — hard, smooth, and built to wipe clean and resist daily kitchen wear.
